LanguageData.CS_Settings_MistsEnabled_Tooltip: Whether the mists rise at night. When disabled, the mists will not appear.
LanguageData.CS_Settings_MistsFrequency_Tooltip: How often will the mists come at night
LanguageData.CS_Settings_PawnsKeepVialOnDown_Tooltip: Should pawns drop all their vials when they get downed? Note they will still drop them when they die, regardless of this setting.
LanguageData.CS_Settings_PawnsKeepMetalmindsOnDown_To: Should pawns drop all their metalminds when they get downed? Note they will still drop them when they die, regardless of this setting.
LanguageData.CS_Settings_AlwaysShowAuras_Tooltip: When enabled, iron, steel, and bronze sight lines draw for every burning allomancer, not just the one selected. Can clutter the view in large colonies.
